parsed.post: The attempt to increase DEPTH to 8 resulted in a val_bpb of 0.865314, which is worse than our current best (0.852968). Increasing model capacity without adjusting the learning rate or training duration likely led to underfitting within the 5-minute budget. Reverting to c5eaa8b.
parsed.description: Reverting DEPTH to 6 and slightly increasing learning rate while decreasing weight decay to see if higher learning rate helps convergence within the budget.
